description: Mark a contact as spam (isSpam=true) or clear the flag (isSpam=false). Marking as spam also opts the contact out of marketing (consent=false), so they are excluded from broadcasts and hidden from the active chat list. Unmarking spam does NOT automatically restore marketing consent — use gambot_set_contact_consent for that.

isSpam.description: true = mark as spam (and opt-out); false = clear the spam flag.

phone.description: Phone number, ideally E.164 international format (country code, digits only, no leading 0), e.g. 972501234567 or 12025551234. A local/national number (e.g. leading 0) is accepted when a country is provided — or when the organization has a saved country from onboarding; otherwise it's rejected as ambiguous.

name: gambot_mark_contact_spam
title: Mark / unmark contact as spam
